responsibility: Implements GCC’s core dump-file and optimization-report infrastructure. It owns global dump streams and flags, the registry of built-in dump kinds and dump option keywords, pass dump-file setup/teardown through gcc::dump_manager, parsing and enabling of -fdump-* and -fopt-info selections, coordination with dump_context so pending optinfo records are flushed across pass boundaries, and the concrete dump entry points that route textual IR/analysis output and optimization messages to pass dumps, alternate opt-info streams, and optimization-record emission.
same_name_distinction: This is the dumpfile group's implementation file: it defines the dump option tables, global dump streams/flags, dump_manager behavior, and the concrete routing of dumps and opt-info output. Unlike dumpfile.h, which declares flags, enums, helper types, and APIs, this file owns the operational state and code behind them.
